body.x: PEOS participated in the "2024 Future Innovation tech eXpo (FIX 2024)" held from October 23 to October 26 at Daegu EXCO. Established as a private company in 2017 and later incorporated under Juwon Co., Ltd. in 2023, PEOS specializes in developing and manufacturing power conversion and signal conversion devices. Their product range includes controllers for unmanned drones, power supplies for EV chargers and e-scooter chargers, DC converters for secondary battery charging and discharging, and dental processing equipment.

At FIX 2024, PEOS showcased its hybrid wireless power converter, a dual-mode wireless and wired charger supplied to CHAEVI. The converter supports 1.5kW and 48V with WPC specifications. LIG Nex1 and Shinil Information Technology also use the portable ground control station (GCS) for military applications.

PEOS’s core development areas include power conversion devices, thermal and fluid analysis, transformers, inductors, mechanical design (Fusion 360), multi-signal processing, firmware development (PIC, TI), battery management systems (BMS), application development (C#-Visual Studio), and electronic controls.

body.x: FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
